LoadingTipInfo:
The first place encountered by Adventurers seeking the Forsaken Land.
A scorching hot sun and carved cliffs fill the wasteland.

As a new era of grand adventure dawns, more seek the Forsaken Land.
The encampments built by adventurers from various nations serve as the foundation of the allied city of Babylon.

A satellite city under construction led by the Merchants Guild.
They focus on pioneering agricultural lands centered around Taima Oasis.

The garrison of the Bardad Expedition operating in the Forsaken Land.
Based in a Waypoint in Gale Ravine, they dispatch their members throughout the Forsaken Land.

Com um ambiente natural abençoado, este lugar é um dos principais habitats da Naruru Tribe.
A região ao redor de Ea's Navel abriga vegetação e monstros variados.

The largest of the Naruru Tribe's Waypoints existing in the Forsaken Land.
Located near Ea's Navel, it consists of floating houses.

A ranch that breeds Rappie, the mounts of the Forsaken Land.
Located in an area rich with food, it is operated by the Naruru Tribe.

A brewery that crafts traditional liquor containing the secret recipe of the Naruru Tribe.
Clean water from the valley and homegrown Baba are used as the main ingredients.

Um lugar onde é possível admirar as Ridges e suas elevações bizarras.
A Hallowed Mountain, com seus picos pontiagudos de aparência artificial, é impressionante.

A Village being pioneered with Xavier as the central figure.
They are actively resisting the invasions of the Ironblood Brigade and the Kiguru Tribe.

The garrison dispatched from the Frantia Kingdom resides here.
It borders the territory of the Kiguru Tribe, yet maintains a peaceful atmosphere.

A place where Rappie are trained in running, jumping, and more.
Rumor has it that they suffer from even more severe financial difficulties than the Rappie Ranch.

A place where an endless ice cliff serves as a barrier.
Adventurers willingly step into this snowfield that no one else sought out.

A Stormkel outpost focused on recruit training and resource research.
It is infamous among soldiers for its harsh training and frequent deaths from overwork.

The final destination for stragglers wandering the Forsaken Land.
A place where the sick and those who can no longer climb the Tower hope for a better tomorrow.

A gateway located at the borderlands of Stormkel.
Missions are carried out beneath an ice wall that is essentially a natural fortress.

A hot spring discovered by adventurous Narurus.
It is one of the places frequently visited by outpost soldiers to recharge.

A war refugee hideout, hidden behind breathtaking cliffs.
Only the steps of adventurers can heal these scarred cliffs.

A village where hunters from the Crea Empire and the Adventurers Alliance
mingle freely, regardless of origin.

Where the Bardad Expedition stays to fulfill a special purpose in the Barrens.
They study the tower's floating debris to unearth ancient secrets.

Where those who fled the Crean expansion have made their new home.
For them, these tunnels may become a place where they live to see another tomorrow.

A place where the Ragar Tribe, who manage the Tower, recreated part of the ancient empire's royal castle.
The Aether fluctuations are unstable, making it possible to encounter beings from unknown worlds.

A place where the Ragar Tribe, who manage the Tower, recreated part of the ancient empire's royal castle.
The Aether fluctuations are unstable, making it possible to encounter beings from unknown worlds.

A realm where points in the past, present, and future exist in a tangled mix.
It is said that reaching a certain inflection point presents an opportunity for Upgrade.

A high-risk zone that those seeking to amass boundless wealth ulTaimately reach.
Those willing to pay a price greater than their own lives flock here in pursuit of their desires.

A place too significant to approach out of mere curiosity.
When the cravings of adventurers converge, a battlefield of endless greed and obstinacy unfolds.

A repository of the ancient empire, said to be managed by the Ragar Tribe.
You can acquire Costume Threads required to increase Costume levels and materials needed for Transcendence.

A repository of the ancient empire, said to be managed by the Ragar Tribe.
You can acquire Skill Training Books required to increase Skill levels and materials needed for Transcendence.

A repository of the ancient empire, said to be managed by the Ragar Tribe.
You can acquire Stardust required to increase Card levels and materials needed for Transcendence.

A repository of the ancient empire, said to be managed by the Ragar Tribe.
You can secure Gold that is used throughout the Forsaken Land.

Numerous Trial Gates exist in the Forsaken Land.
Tackle various forms of trials using your own unique strategies.

Adventurers learn a surprising fact through their Codex.
The place they teleported to via the Trial Gate was none other than the inside of the Giant's Tower.

Trial Gates are said to have been created by the Great Sage Atrahasis.
However, their exact purpose remains unknown, making them a subject of study for scholars.

The Trial Gate entrance device is a product of the ancient empire.
Since it cannot be replicated with current technology, it is presumed to be a spatial teleportation device.

A battlefield where warriors fight to honor Asbjorn, creator of the Halo Festival.
Surrounded by gold on all sides, just standing still overwhelms you with its brilliance.

Entities that once ruled the Forsaken Land and hunted humans are suddenly trapped in a dungeon.
Dreaming of revenge against the one who imprisoned them, they wield their weapons once more today.

The Explorers’ Guild discovered the hideout of the monsters that drove the Forsaken Land into terror.
There stood an ancient castle holding the remnants of a ruined kingdom and a deep underground cavern.

A grand expedition united by the shared resolve of the Forsaken Land's Adventurers.
The presence of allies leading the way through the front lines serves as the most reliable beacon in the darkness.

The aether leylines, torn away by Averus, simply exist, bound to nowhere. 
They can mimic the forms of past space and time, but their true essence has already been lost to the void.

A lair of an unidentified creature, rumored by some to be one of the ancient primates.
Its overwhelming size cannot be hidden, not even by these towering walls.

Adventurers of the Forsaken Land speak with one voice regarding the Trial of Leap.
They say that after countless falls, you eventually forget how to even spread your wings.

There is but one way to truly savor the Trial of Flight.
Forget the touch of the earth beneath your feet. Only then can you experience ultimate velocity.

Those who conquered the Trial of Wisdom advise you to empty your mind.
Trust your first instinct, and press on.

No bounty is placed on the monsters and beasts born of the Ethereal.
Nevertheless, the feat of conquering the Trial of Combat is worthy of the highest honor.

An unpredictable, unknown realm that appears and disappears during specific periods.
The apprentice priests and trainees of Enkia called this the Rabbit Hole Enigma.

The hall is reserved for those who prove their strength before the ancient nexus. 
When the season of trials draws to a close, records become history and a new season dawns.

The ulTaimate culmination of the ruined ancient empire's civilization.
Adventurers head to the Tower seeking the power to change the world.

The Tower was built based on the design of the Great Sage Atrahasis.
Standing firmly at the center of the world, the Tower has shared in the rise and fall of humanity.

An arena created for the amusement of the ancient empire's nobles.
It is said to be a place built to spectate bloody battles between beasts and humans.

A hallowed ground honoring the Three Wings that brought down the sun.
The legacy of their grand ascent is etched into the capital of Frantia.
